summary: Develop oil and gas workforce plans, competency matrices and HR dashboards. Explore the five-day intermediate course and review its practical outcomes.
lede: Human resource management in oil and gas covers workforce planning, competency assurance and employee processes that support operational staffing. For HR practitioners, workforce planners and operations leaders, this intermediate course develops practical skills to map critical roles, assess competency gaps and plan succession coverage. Participants also practise contractor onboarding, roster coverage reviews and workforce reporting with Excel-based indicators, using ISO 10015 and ISO 45001 as references.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals whose people decisions affect staffing continuity, competency assurance and workforce readiness across oil and gas operations. It suits intermediate learners with HR or operational workforce responsibilities.
audience: Oil and Gas HR Business Partners
modules: HR Dashboard and Workforce Action Plan
prerequisites: Prior experience in human resources, workforce administration or operational people management is expected. You should be familiar with employee records and workplace staffing processes. No coding or programming is required; exercises use workforce scenarios and spreadsheet calculations.
